**Leadership & Team Development** – Building and scaling high-performing analytics organizations.

*Built and scaled a matrixed analytics organization by hiring and mentoring a co-director and more than 10 analysts. Expanded the team from supporting 2 customers to more than 65 customers and $70M+ in ARR in just three years while fostering a culture of technical excellence and continuous learning.*

&nbsp;

**Data Science & Advanced Analytics** – Applying machine learning, predictive analytics, and statistical methodologies to solve complex healthcare challenges.

*Design scalable analytics frameworks, predictive models, and data products that transform real-world healthcare data into actionable insights across healthcare, life sciences, and technology.*

&nbsp;

**Healthcare & Life Sciences Research** – Advancing evidence generation using electronic health record data and real-world evidence.

*Author of multiple peer-reviewed publications and more than 10 scientific conference abstracts using EHR data to address clinically meaningful questions in cardiovascular disease, pulmonary embolism, GLP-1 therapies, and other real-world evidence applications.*

&nbsp;

**Communication & Enablement** – Making advanced analytics accessible through education and technical enablement.

*Developed researcher training programs, webinars, workshops, and technical content that have helped hundreds of researchers adopt advanced analytics platforms and best practices. Visit **Workshops & Outreach** to learn more.*

&nbsp;

**Customer Strategy & Analytics Enablement** – Helping healthcare and life sciences organizations unlock value from complex data.

*Designed and scaled enterprise analytics programs supporting many of the world's leading pharmaceutical and healthcare organizations, enabling customers to conduct research efficiently and at scale using Truveta's EHR platform.*

&nbsp;

**Cross-Functional Leadership** – Bridging technical and business teams to accelerate innovation.

*Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Commercial, and Customer Success teams to translate customer needs into platform capabilities. Founded the company-wide **Code & Tell** forum to promote technical knowledge sharing and customer-driven product development.*

&nbsp;

**Strategy & Business Impact** – Connecting analytics investments to measurable business outcomes.

*Designed executive reporting and customer intelligence solutions integrating Salesforce, billing, platform usage, and operational data into a unified customer health framework that supports strategic planning and operational decision-making.*

&nbsp;

**Technical Expertise** – Programming languages, analytics platforms, and healthcare technologies.

*Python • R • SQL • Spark • Databricks • SPSS • DataRobot • Truveta Studio*
